parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human Cytochrome P450 2C9. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target pref_name 'Cytochrome P450 2C9' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Require structures by inner joining compound_structures on molregno. Return columns aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
